evidence.note: The collapsible camping chair is fully folded and stored upright in the corner.
The chair fabric fills the foreground while the chair is being unfolded.
The chair is visibly deployed with its seat, back, arms, and legs open.
The chair remains deployed immediately before the closing episode.
The chair is folded and stored upright in the corner again.

events.object_description: Dark collapsible camping chair near the interior wall corner; first unfold-and-refold episode.

evidence.note: The camping chair is folded in the corner.
Large chair fabric and frame components are close to the camera during deployment.
The chair is fully open beside the window and desk.
The chair is still deployed beside the wall.
The chair is folded and returned to the window-side corner.

events.object_description: Same collapsible camping chair, manipulated in a second distinct unfold-and-refold episode beside the desk/window.

evidence.note: The blue camping chair is folded in the window-side corner.
Blue chair fabric fills the foreground as the chair is pulled out and unfolded.
The blue chair is fully deployed beside the desk.
The chair remains open immediately before being collapsed.
The chair is partially obscured and moving during the closing action.
The chair is folded back into the corner.

events.object_description: Blue collapsible camping chair; third distinct unfold-and-refold episode near the window.

notes: Three separate localized manipulation episodes are visible. Each changes the collapsible chair from folded (off) to deployed (on), leaves it deployed, and then folds it again. The intervening camera traversals were not counted.
scene_description: A bright bedroom with a bed, standing desk, monitor, window, and a collapsible camping chair repeatedly moved between folded storage in a corner and an open seating configuration.
